# RitualDev

> Autonomous AI Agent Defense, Kernel Sandboxing, Database Wire Proxies & Zero-Leak Studio.

RitualDev (https://ritualdev.in) is an independent engineering platform building zero-trust kernel sandboxing, database wire proxies, and progressive token compaction to protect developer infrastructure against prompt injection, credential exfiltration, and destructive database mutations.

## Core Products

- [AgentShield](https://ritualdev.in/agentshield): Zero-leak secret defense & OS kernel sandboxing (Bubblewrap, Landlock, Seatbelt, AppContainer) for autonomous AI coding agents.
- [DBShield](https://ritualdev.in/dbshield): Database wire protocol proxy with virtual schema masking, two-phase dry-run simulation, and Slack/Teams ChatOps approval bots.
- [SkillPrism](https://ritualdev.in/skillprism): Progressive context compaction engine cutting LLM prompt bloat by 96.7% using JIT disclosure.
- [DevShelf](https://ritualdev.in/devshelf): Community directory of 567+ verified developer tools, free APIs, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
- [WebSecAuditor](https://ritualdev.in/web-sec-auditor): AST taint analysis scanner and turnkey GitHub PR review bot with 1-click remediation.
- [MCPBuilderKit](https://ritualdev.in/mcp-builder): Production scaffolding engine converting OpenAPI REST specifications into typed MCP servers.
- [Ritual Agent Defense IDE Extension](https://ritualdev.in/extension): Extension for Cursor, VS Code, and Windsurf providing real-time sandbox telemetry.
- [Enterprise Governance Suite](https://ritualdev.in/enterprise): Air-gapped VPC modules, Terraform templates, and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 cryptographic audit reporting.

## Commercial Subscriptions & Pricing

- [Pricing & Subscriptions](https://ritualdev.in/pricing): Free community open-source CLI, $15/mo Pro Individual, $99/mo Team Hub, and custom Enterprise VPC.
- [Pro Delivery Portal](https://ritualdev.in/pricing/success): Instant license key generation, CLI activation, desktop GUI downloads, and MCP proxy configs.

## Developer & Machine Endpoints

- [Tools API Endpoint](https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/tools.json): Direct JSON feed of 567+ developer tools and MCP servers.
- [Categories API Endpoint](https://ritualdev.in/api/v1/categories.json): Machine-readable catalog hierarchy.
- [DevShelf RSS Feed](https://ritualdev.in/feed.xml): Real-time XML syndication feed.
- [DevShelf Atom Feed](https://ritualdev.in/atom.xml): Real-time Atom syndication feed.
